description: Read a SMALL object inline (≤1 MiB, returned base64) — for manifests, sidecars, and configs the agent must inspect — or stream any size to a local path with saveToPath. saveToPath writes the fetched bytes to the local filesystem (creating parent directories) via a temporary sibling file that replaces the target only after a complete download, so a failed transfer leaves any existing file untouched; it performs no mutation of B2 or any remote data. For real object data, generate a GetObject URL with s3_get_presigned_url and download directly from B2 (bytes never pass through the server or the model context).

saveToPath.description: If provided, save the file to this local path.

versionId.description: Specific version of the object to retrieve.

name: s3_get_object
